name: knowledge-work-plugins
description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
one_liner: A free pack of ready-made 'skill sets' that teach an AI assistant how to do specific jobs — sales, legal, finance, support — so it acts like a specialist instead of a generic chatbot.
buyer: An operations or IT lead at a mid-size company rolling out AI tools to non-technical teams (sales, legal, finance) who wants the assistant to already know their function's workflows.
business_use_cases: A consultancy customizes the 'legal' or 'finance' plugin with a client's own templates and tool connections, then sells the customized setup as a packaged implementation.
An agency builds and sells a bespoke plugin for an underserved role (e.g. real estate, recruiting) not in the official set, filling the gap for a niche industry.
An IT team standardizes company-wide on the 'productivity' plugin, cutting onboarding time for new hires learning internal tools.

money_ideas.idea: Sell paid implementation and customization services: adapt a plugin to a specific company's tools, terminology, and workflows.
Build and sell original plugins for roles or industries the official marketplace doesn't cover yet.

steal_this: Pick one underserved role (e.g. property management, recruiting) and build a complete plugin for it this weekend, then sell setup-and-customization packages to small firms in that niche.
